# FantasyPros

> > FantasyPros is the leading fantasy sports platform providing expert consensus rankings, accuracy tracking, and partner solutions for NFL, MLB, and NBA fantasy leagues.

FantasyPros aggregates expert opinions from top analysts like David Dodds and platforms like FootballGuys and Yahoo! Sports to deliver data-driven fantasy sports advice. The platform offers partner APIs, marketing solutions, and comprehensive tools for player rankings, waiver wire pickups, and draft strategy across multiple sports.

## Key Topics

- Expert consensus rankings
- Fantasy football player rankings
- Waiver wire pickups
- Expert accuracy tracking
- NFL fantasy sports (Green Bay Packers, Carolina Panthers, Jacksonville Jaguars, New Orleans Saints, Houston Texans, Seattle Seahawks, Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals)
- MLB fantasy baseball
- NBA fantasy basketball
- Draft strategy and tools
- Standard scoring formats
- Running backs and wide receivers
- Partner program and API solutions
- Marketing integrations
- Top experts (David Dodds, John Paulsen, Jordan Tozzi, Mike Clay, Josh Shepardson)
- Boris Chen tiered rankings
- PAY accuracy system

## Partner Program & API Solutions

- [FantasyPros Partners HQ](https://partnershq.fantasypros.com/): Partner program hub for NFL/MLB/NBA fantasy sports API and marketing tools
- [Solutions](https://partnershq.fantasypros.com/solutions): Partner solutions for fantasy sports data, sponsorships, and integrations

## Expert Accuracy Reports

- [The Best Fantasy Football Experts (Multi-Year Accuracy Report)](https://www.fantasypros.com/2013/08/best-fantasy-football-experts-multi-year-accuracy): Multi-year accuracy rankings featuring David Dodds and Jamey Eisenberg
- [2013's Most Accurate Fantasy Football Experts](https://www.fantasypros.com/2013/12/most-accurate-fantasy-experts): 2013 accuracy standings with Jordan Tozzi and Mike Clay top performers
- [2012's Most Accurate Baseball Experts](https://www.fantasypros.com/2013/02/most-accurate-fantasy-baseball-experts): 2012 MLB expert accuracy report featuring Josh Shepardson and PAY system
- [2010's Most Accurate Fantasy Football Expert](https://www.fantasypros.com/2010/12/most-accurate-fantasy-football-expert): 2010 accuracy results revealing John Paulsen as top fantasy expert

## Waiver Wire Rankings & Pickups

- [Waiver Wire Rankings: Expert Pickups for Week 3](https://www.fantasypros.com/2015/09/waiver-wire-expert-pickups-for-week-3): Week 3 waiver rankings led by Dion Lewis and Devonta Freeman
- [Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Pickups: Week 1](https://www.fantasypros.com/2015/09/fantasy-football-waiver-wire-pickups-week-1): Week 1 waiver targets including Christine Michael and Marcus Mariota
- [Waiver Wire Rankings: Expert Pickups for Week 5](https://www.fantasypros.com/2014/09/waiver-wire-rankings-expert-pickups-for-week-5): Week 5 waiver pickups featuring Jerick McKinnon and Teddy Bridgewater
- [Waiver Wire Rankings: Expert Pickups for Week 8](https://www.fantasypros.com/2015/10/waiver-wire-expert-pickups-for-week-8): Week 8 pickups post-Arian Foster injury featuring Alfred Blue
- [Waiver Wire Rankings: Who Should You Pick Up In Week 11?](https://www.fantasypros.com/2013/11/waiver-wire-rankings-week-11): Week 11 waiver wire pickups featuring Michael Crabtree and Andre Brown

## Draft Strategy & Player Analysis

- [2015 Fantasy Football Strength of Schedule Rankings: By Team](https://www.fantasypros.com/2015/06/2015-fantasy-football-strength-of-schedule): 2015 team-by-team schedule analysis for draft strategy planning
- [Fantasy Football: Analyzing WRs No. 10-20](https://www.fantasypros.com/2015/09/fantasy-football-analyzing-wrs-no-10-20): Draft analysis of WR10-20 tier featuring T.Y. Hilton and Mike Evans
- [Fantasy Football: Third-Option WRs](https://www.fantasypros.com/2015/07/fantasy-football-third-option-wrs): Sleeper WR3s analysis including Brandon LaFell for deep league targets
- [Five More Fantasy Football Twitter Accounts to Follow](https://www.fantasypros.com/2015/08/five-more-fantasy-football-twitter-accounts-to-follow): Recommended Twitter follows including Chris Raybon for fantasy advice
